installH1.message: To start, you need to pair this extension with the 2FAS Auth mobile application.

installRecoveredMessage.message: The extension's encryption key was lost, so the extension has been reset and your previous pairing no longer works. Please pair it with your device again. The old pairing has been removed from your 2FAS app; if it is still listed there, you can remove it by hand.

installScan.message: Scan this code with your 2FAS Auth mobile app

installStep3.message: Tap "Pair with web browser" and scan the QR code

installSuccessHeader.message: 2FAS Browser Extension is successfully paired with your 2FAS Auth app

installSuccessSubheader.message: Now you can quickly autofill Two-Factor forms with mobile app confirmation.
